faq.question: What JSON input does this tool accept?
faq.answer: The tool accepts a JSON array whose items are objects, for example [{"name":"Alice"},{"name":"Bob"}]. Each object becomes a table row and the object keys become column names.

faq.question: Can I convert a single JSON object to a table?
faq.answer: This page is designed primarily for arrays of records. A single object is better represented as a key-value view. Wrap multiple records in an array or use a JSON viewer designed for object inspection.

faq.question: Can I convert nested JSON to a table?
faq.answer: Yes, when the input contains nested objects you can enable Flatten nested objects. Nested keys are represented as dot-notation columns such as customer.name or address.city. Arrays and complex nested values may require additional transformation before they can fit into a flat table.

faq.question: What happens when different rows have different keys?
faq.answer: The table can use the union of keys found across the input objects as columns. Rows that do not contain a particular key will have an empty cell for that column.

faq.question: Can I copy the generated HTML?
faq.answer: Yes. Click Copy HTML to copy the generated table markup. The result is intended for static HTML use in web pages, documentation, emails, or other HTML-compatible destinations.

faq.question: Does the generated HTML include CSS styles?
faq.answer: The generated output contains the table markup supported by this page. Styling depends on the implementation and may require your own CSS or an existing stylesheet.

faq.question: Can I download the table as CSV?
faq.answer: Yes. Click Download CSV to export the table data. CSV is suitable for spreadsheet applications such as Excel and Google Sheets, although the exact handling of nested values depends on the selected flattening option.

faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: This page processes the JSON in your browser and does not require an upload to a conversion server. You should still avoid entering passwords, API keys, access tokens, or other highly sensitive information into any browser-based tool.

faq.question: Can I convert a large JSON file?
faq.answer: The practical limit depends on your browser, device memory, number of rows, number of columns, and the complexity of nested values. Very large files may take longer to parse or render than smaller arrays.

faq.question: Why does the tool say that the input must be an array?
faq.answer: A flat table requires multiple records, so the page expects a top-level JSON array. If your data is wrapped inside an object such as {"results":[...]}, extract the results array before converting it.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON to table converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste or open JSON, render the table, copy the generated HTML, and download CSV without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert JSON to an HTML Table
article.content:
What Is a JSON to Table Converter?

A JSON to table converter transforms structured JSON records into rows and columns that are easier to read and reuse. The most common input is an array of objects, where each object represents one record and each property becomes a table column.

For example, an array containing users, products, API results, or database records can be easier to inspect as a table than as raw JSON text. This tool generates an HTML table and can also export the displayed data as CSV.

Supported JSON Structure

The recommended input is a top-level array of objects:

[{"name":"Alice","age":30},{"name":"Bob","age":25}]

The object keys are used as column names, and each object becomes a table row. If different objects contain different keys, the final set of columns may include keys from more than one row, with empty cells where a value is missing.

How to Convert JSON to an HTML Table

  1. Enter JSON: Paste an array of objects into the editor or open a .json file.
  2. Choose nested handling: Enable the flattening option if nested objects should become separate columns.
  3. Render the table: Click Render Table to parse the JSON and display the result.
  4. Review the data: Check the row count, column count, headers, and values before exporting.
  5. Copy or download: Copy the generated HTML markup or download the table as a CSV file.

Flattening Nested JSON

Flat tables work best when each cell contains a scalar value such as a string, number, boolean, or null. Nested objects do not naturally fit into a single flat cell, so the optional flattening mode converts paths into column names.

For example, this object:

{"user":{"name":"Alice"},"address":{"city":"New York"}}

may become columns such as user.name and address.city. Nested arrays are more difficult because they can contain multiple values or objects. Depending on the conversion rules, they may be serialized into one cell or require a separate transformation.

JSON to HTML Table vs JSON to CSV

HTML tables are useful when the result will be displayed inside a web page, documentation, or an HTML-compatible editor. CSV is better suited to spreadsheet applications, data analysis, and workflows that require a downloadable delimited file.

  • HTML table: Use when you need table markup with rows, columns, headings, and cells.
  • CSV: Use when you need to open the result in Excel, Google Sheets, or another spreadsheet application.
  • Raw JSON: Keep the original format when nested structure, data types, or machine-to-machine exchange must be preserved.

HTML Safety and Escaping

Values copied into HTML should be escaped before they are inserted into table cells. Characters such as <, >, &, and quotation marks can have special meaning in HTML. A safe converter should escape cell values so that JSON content is treated as text rather than interpreted as markup.

Do not assume that converting JSON to HTML makes untrusted data safe in every context. If you insert the generated output into a larger application, follow that application's HTML and content-security practices.

Common Input Problems

  • Top-level object: The tool expects an array of records, but the input starts with { instead of [.
  • Invalid JSON: The document contains a missing comma, unmatched bracket, invalid quote, or another syntax error.
  • Empty array: The input contains no records to display.
  • Mixed row types: Some array items are objects while others are strings, numbers, or arrays.
  • Inconsistent fields: Different records contain different keys, which may create empty cells or additional columns.
  • Large data: Very large arrays may use considerable browser memory and may take longer to render.

Using the Generated HTML

After copying the output, paste it into an HTML page, documentation system, CMS editor, email template, or other destination that accepts table markup. You may need to add CSS for borders, spacing, responsive behavior, colors, and typography.

The generated table is static HTML. It does not automatically provide sorting, filtering, pagination, editing, responsive controls, or accessibility behavior beyond the markup generated by the page. Those features require additional HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.

Browser-Based Privacy

This tool is designed to parse JSON and generate the table in your browser instead of uploading the input to a remote conversion service. That can be useful for internal datasets and development data, but it is not a guarantee of complete security. Avoid entering credentials, access tokens, personal information, or confidential production data into any web-based tool.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有 JSON 解析和表格生成都在浏览器本地完成，数据不会离开你的设备，也不会被存储或传输到任何地方。

faq.question: 可以复制 HTML 代码吗？
faq.answer: 可以。你可以复制生成的 HTML 表格代码，粘贴到网页、文档、邮件或其他支持 HTML 的地方直接使用。

faq.question: 支持嵌套 JSON 对象吗？
faq.answer: 支持。启用“展平嵌套对象”后，嵌套结构会被展开为点号表示的列（例如 address.city、user.name），使嵌套数据能够适配扁平的表格视图。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以转换较大的 JSON 文件，只要浏览器能够加载和处理它们。实际限制取决于设备性能、浏览器可用内存以及数据的复杂程度。

faq.question: 这个工具和 JSON 转 CSV 有什么区别？
faq.answer: JSON 转表格主要创建用于网页或文档中可视化展示的 HTML 表格视图。JSON 转 CSV 则生成可下载的 CSV 文件，更适合在 Excel、Google Sheets 等电子表格应用中进行分析和处理。

faq.question: 可以下载表格为 CSV 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。点击“下载 CSV”可以将表格数据导出为 CSV 文件，兼容 Excel、Google Sheets 和其他主流电子表格应用。

faq.question: 可以在自己的网站中使用这个表格吗？
faq.answer: 可以。生成的 HTML 表格是标准、语义化的 HTML，可以直接嵌入到你的网页中。如有需要，还可以使用自己的 CSS 进一步美化样式。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的 JSON 转表格转换器吗？
faq.answer: 是的。这是一个免费的在线 JSON 转表格转换器。你可以粘贴 JSON 数组或上传文件，渲染 HTML 表格，并复制或导出结果，无需创建账号或将数据上传到服务器。
